summary: ISIT 2027, the IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory from the IEEE Information Theory Society, takes place from 27 June to 2 July 2027 in Sorrento, Italy. This call is for researchers in information theory who want to submit a paper or propose a tutorial. Paper submissions are due 10 January 2027 at 23:59 Anywhere on Earth, with acceptance notifications on 27 March 2027.
highlights: Symposium held onsite in Sorrento, Italy, 27 June to 2 July 2027.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official ISIT 2027 page before applying.
